ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: large contiguous white area bounded by a dark trailing edge, containing multiple thin black linear streaks. Right lobe: dominant dark grey/black area with localized white intensity mapping near the median notch and a vertical white streak on the distal right margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated internal pixel angle of 40 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to both lobes, sweeping upward from the median notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast tan and white circular pixel groups (barnacles) located at the distal tips and along segments of the trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths crossing the white pigmentation on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, textured brownish-tan barnacle encrustations at the distal tips of both lobes, particularly dense and protruding on the right extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion at the lower central region due to high-intensity water spray and cavitation artifacts at the fluke-water interface.
